name: Sunresin New Materials Co.,Ltd
summary: Sunresin New Materials Co.,Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, production, and sales of adsorption and separation materials, in China and internationally. The company offers adsorbent, catalyst, chelating, ion exchange, mixed bed ion exchange, powder, strong acid cation exchange, strong base anion exchange, weak acid cation exchange, and weak base anion exchange resins; chromatographic media; enzyme carriers; solid phase peptide synthesis products; and exchange separation system devices.
